scope: Proposition 10.2 of the manuscript “Relative independence of the separable quotient problem” (preprints/Relative-independence-of-the-separable-quotient-problem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 323 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 77cc28d21bfb07f7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If ZFC with a measurable cardinal is consistent, then ZFC with a real-valued measurable continuum is consistent.
